credentials.description: OAuth token from your Yango Delivery account (Integration tab, Get token); changing the account password invalidates it

parameters.name: claim_id
parameters.description: Claim ID received at the claim creation stage

example_prompt: Confirm a priced Yango Delivery claim so that a courier is dispatched for the order.

version.description: Claim version. Changed after the claim was edited (int64)

id.description: Claim ID obtained at the claim creation stage

status.description: Claim status. To learn more, see Status model (https://yango-delivery.viewer.diplodoc.yandex.ru/en/api/express/claim-process.md)

user_request_revision.description: The current version of changes in the claim entered by the user

gotchas: Authenticate with 'Authorization: Bearer <OAuth token>'. The token comes from your Yango Delivery account (log in with the credentials your Yango Delivery manager gives you, Integration tab, Get token). It remains valid indefinitely, but changing the account password invalidates it; an invalid token answers 401 unauthorized.
Confirming starts the courier search: the status becomes accepted, then performer_lookup.

The offer is valid 10 minutes after ready_for_approval. The FAQ says confirming an expired offer still answers 200 and the claim then turns failed, while this endpoint also documents a 409 offer_expired: handle both, and check the status afterwards with get_delivery_claim. Before confirming, an expired offer can be re-evaluated by editing the claim or by creating a new claim with a new request_id; once the claim is failed, create a new claim.

Before confirming, read warnings[]: the FAQ says not_fit_in_car can come together with the ready_for_approval status when the items may not fit the vehicle, and check_delivery_price notes that a courier can refuse items exceeding the allowed dimensions on site, with the minimum fee withheld.
Send the claim's current version (from get_delivery_claim); each edit increases it. The 409 codes include old_version, named without a description.

Errors return { code, message }: branch on code. Documented on this endpoint: 404 not_found; 409 inappropriate_status, old_version, offer_expired, state_mismatch; 429 too_many_requests. The error guide adds 401 unauthorized (invalid token) and 500 (try again or change the request).
Accept-Language is a required header on this endpoint (e.g. en); this example sends en.

No test environment is documented: requests go to the production host, and confirming a claim starts the search for a courier. The error guide mentions test accounts (required_tariffs_disabled_for_user: 'Test account has expired or the specified rate is disabled') — ask your manager for one before testing.
open_questions: No test environment is documented: the API reference gives only the service URL b2b.delivery.yango.tech, and confirming a claim starts a real courier search. Ask your Yango Delivery manager for a test account.
